primary_endpoint: Histological improvement in NASH, including fibrosis improvement.
efficacy_outcome: OCA improved NASH fibrosis versus control (OR 1.95, 95% CI 1.47–2.59; p<0.001); results were significant for 10 mg (OR 1.61; p=0.03) and 25 mg (OR 2.23; p<0.001).
safety_signal: In NASH, 25 mg OCA increased adverse events leading to discontinuation (OR 2.8; p<0.001), while 10 mg did not (OR 0.95; p=0.84). Pruritus risk was lowest with 5 mg OCA.
